comment: The three gate jacks are levels rather than edges: each is summed with its own button and compared with 0.5V, so a steady 1V holds the gate open. The rates are ten raised to the knob's -2 to +2, which is 0.01 to 100 volts per second, divided by a hundred in super-slow mode. The accumulator itself is always kept between 0 and 10V internally and the bipolar switch subtracts 5V on the way out, which is why a reset in bipolar mode lands on -5V rather than 0V. The panel prints cumuli, up, rst, down, out, ±5V and 0-10V; the two rate knobs, the three buttons and the switch carry no lettering of their own beyond the section names.
